metadata.description: Spouse of Tata, the second Elf-father. She was awakened by Tata at Cuiviénen during the Years of the Trees. Together with Tata and their 54 companions, they became the Tatyar ('Seconds') – the second clan of Elves. Her descendants became the ancestors of the Noldor (those who followed Finwë to Aman) and the Tatyarin Avari (those who remained behind with Morwë and/or Nurwë). Her children included Maidros and Nurwe.
